method_notes: Method A: general skilled-model search, with adaptive official-editor, configuration-API, and browser-diagnostic queries.
Only system2_search_query was used for discovery; all explicit page retrievals used the same web tool.
Each search returned twelve results. All ranks are retained exactly; no missing top-five ranks. Search exposure is not counted as direct reading.
Some independent retrievals overlapped. Event indices are assigned by recorded start UTC; timings bracket the web call and include local timing overhead.
The exact 647-byte natural-input block hashes to the supplied SHA-256. The report's 3.13 spelling was retained rather than silently normalized.

Query 1 rank 2 exposed later same-request forum replies and a claimed resolution. Outcome blindness is contaminated. This was disclosed to the parent, not opened, and excluded from candidate evidence; cognitive independence cannot be restored.
Three actual primary links were directly read. URL variants of a work are not independent evidence. No further queries or opens were needed.
All three failure tests are proposals. No live Node-RED instance, browser session, API, source implementation, or fix was tested.

final_candidates.input_processing_observation: The supplied reproduction uses a workspace-tab double-click; the pane opens but the naming properties are missing.
final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: An alternate menu entry is absent from the supplied report. The double-click flow editor itself is the existing baseline; neither entry point is a new invention.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Compare the two entry points before classifying the failure as gesture-specific or shared dialog rendering.
final_candidates.minimal_discriminating_input: Proposed only: with the same selected flow and session, open by double-click, cancel, then use Flows > Rename. Record whether each exposes the name field.
final_candidates.expected_output: The documented intended result is an editable flow-name field. A mismatch narrows the fault toward the entry path; identical missing fields favor a shared dialog/state hypothesis.

limitations: No implementation trace proves the two paths are independent. No reproduction or fix was executed.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: The report already says a pane opens, so a pure double-click failure is less plausible; the alternate entry might reach the same failing code.

final_candidates.product_feature: Admin HTTP API replacement of one flow configuration
final_candidates.version_or_date: Current rolling documentation read 2026-11-24; publication and installed-version compatibility unknown.
final_candidates.exact_section: Endpoint description, Headers, Arguments, Response; lines 15–63
final_candidates.input_processing_observation: The report establishes missing editing controls, but provides no test of whether the active configuration accepts another label.
final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: A non-dialog path to changing the flow label is absent from the supplied report; it is an existing API.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Use a disposable empty flow to test the configuration path independently of the missing form.
final_candidates.minimal_discriminating_input: Proposed only: in a disposable instance with an existing empty flow, PUT /flow/<id> with {"id":"<id>","label":"rename-probe","nodes":[],"configs":[]}, appropriate authentication, and JSON content type. Reload and inspect that flow's label.
final_candidates.expected_output: The table documents success as HTTP 204. A retained rename while the dialog still fails supports an editor-side limitation; an API failure requires separate status/payload investigation.
conditions_supported: Requires flows.write; authentication may apply; replacement stops old nodes before starting the new configuration.
limitations: Empty arrays are suitable only for the specified empty test flow. A successful API rename does not identify the missing-tab cause. No API call was executed.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: The page's response table specifies no body, but subsequent prose shows an identifier body. Exact response-body behavior is unverified.
final_candidates.historical_availability: unknown for the exact page edition and reported 3.13 version

final_candidates.title: Find invalid, overridden, inactive, and other CSS
final_candidates.provider: Google Chrome for Developers; Sofia Emelianova
final_candidates.version_or_date: Page states last updated 2022-11-15 UTC; read 2026-11-24.
final_candidates.exact_section: Inspect an element that still isn't styled the way you think; Understand CSS in the Computed pane, lines 160–205
final_candidates.input_processing_observation: The reported browser is Chrome. A visibly missing properties control does not establish whether its DOM element is absent or styled out of view.
final_candidates.what_is_new_vs_baseline: Inspecting the dialog's DOM and resolved CSS is an additional diagnostic absent from the report, using an existing browser facility.
final_candidates.changed_choice: Separate missing-element construction from an existing element's visibility or layout.
final_candidates.minimal_discriminating_input: Proposed only: open the affected dialog, inspect its subtree for the properties entry/name control, and inspect that element and ancestors in Computed. Record visibility-related values and their declaration sources.
final_candidates.expected_output: An existing control plus a hiding rule supports a presentation hypothesis. An absent control leaves construction/state hypotheses. Neither result alone proves the root cause.
conditions_supported: Computed shows resolved rendering values and allows tracing their declaration sources.
limitations: The source is generic Chrome guidance; it does not describe Node-RED selectors or reproduce this issue.
final_candidates.counter_evidence: A visible-looking computed style does not exclude ancestor clipping, overlays, or incorrect element identification.
final_candidates.historical_availability: The displayed update date predates the request; the exact archived edition and reporter's Chrome build remain unknown.
